title: Malicious code in denowrap (PyPI)
description: The denowrap package on PyPI version 1.0.0 contains malicious code identified as a Remote Access Trojan (RAT) from the Quasar/PulsarRAT family. It executes embedded malicious code during installation by overriding the install command in setup.py. The package also includes obfuscation techniques and sandbox detection to evade analysis.
